title: Elegant Brine-Wet Russian Beet Soup Bowl
description: A fresh, tender, and comforting Russian beet soup dish featuring fresh basil and a brine-wet twist, served in a slate-tile vessel
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped beets and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the fresh basil, chicken broth, water, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the beets are tender.
Add the apple cider vinegar and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot in a slate-tile bowl, garnished with additional fresh basil if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
Note: This soup will thicken as it cools, so feel free to add more broth or water to achieve the desired consistency.
Note: For a creamier soup, you can blend a portion of the soup with coconut cream or non-dairy yogurt before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
